## 3. Computational Analysis
*Now, put on your Software Engineer hat. How do we simulate this? Insert your Python code below to model the theory.*

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-simulation
#| fig-cap: "Simulation Results showing System Efficiency"

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# 1. Define the Parameters
x = np.linspace(0, 10, 100)
noise = np.random.normal(0, 0.5, 100)
y = 2 * x + 5 + noise  # Theoretical model + noise

# 2. Plot the results
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))
plt.scatter(x, y, alpha=0.6, label='Observed Data')
plt.plot(x, 2*x + 5, color='red', linestyle='--', label='Theoretical Ideal')

plt.title("Model vs Reality")
plt.xlabel("Input Variable (e.g., Time)")
plt.ylabel("Output Variable (e.g., Efficiency)")
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.show()
